old: return gamma < 1.1 or gamma > 1e6 or mach < 1e-80 or mach > 1e40
new:
if gamma < 1.1 or gamma > 1e6 or mach < 1e-80 or mach > 1e3:
        return True
    energy = 1.0 + 0.5*(gamma-1.0)*mach*mach
    critical = (gamma+1.0)/(2.0*energy)
    # Rounded exponents lose accuracy in proportion to their log arguments.
    # Select complete expressions before that amplification becomes large.
    return max(abs(log(energy)), abs(log(critical)))*gamma/(gamma-1.0) > 16.0
changes.reason: The complete dispatch now also owns power-argument amplification; disabling the entire dispatch preserves the original fault invariant.
Retire the unreachable native overflow catch after complete dispatch. Replace it with a distinct live fault that disables the amplification guard while preserving extreme-input dispatch.

scope: Two explicit within-review fault changes; no historical result is upgraded to apply to new code.
